name: 49829 · Escanaba, MI
findings: ZIP 49829 (Escanaba) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49829 (Escanaba) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49829 (Escanaba) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
